name: Annaugh

attributes.attribute: known only at Collins Wood in Connemara
the genius or spirit of that place

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Annaugh, also called Anna, is an Irish goddess. She is an obscure figure. People knew her in only one place, Collins Wood in Connemara. There she was the genius loci, the guiding spirit of the site.
objective: Record Annaugh (Anna), an Irish goddess of one place.
